description: This file defines the RestXmlParser class, which implements REST-XML parsing functionality for AWS SDK components, particularly for services like S3 and CloudFront.

classes.name: RestXmlParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling REST-XML responses in AWS SDK, utilizing traits and inheriting from AbstractRestParser.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with a Service description and an optional XML parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the request response payload and adds the result to the result array.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses XML data from a stream and transforms it into structured data using the configured parser.
